# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 4 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 11 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #ffffff | #0d1422 | Page and slide background. The default canvas is white, not tinted. |
| `surface-raised` | #ffffff | #182135 | Cards, popovers and any surface that sits above the page. |
| `surface-sunken` | #f4f4f4 | #09101b | Quiet fills, table headers, code blocks and inset panels. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #211f1a | #f7f3ea | Primary text on surface and surface-raised. |
| `ink-strong` | #151d32 | #ffffff | Brand-dark fills, display type and the logo tile. On light slides it reads as near-black navy. |
| `ink-muted` | #716f66 | #aaa69a | Secondary copy, metadata and inactive navigation. |
| `ink-dim` | #a5a296 | #73776f | Tertiary labels and disabled text. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Tight, plain-spoken display type. No outline, no gradient text.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 64px / 66px | 700 | `sans` | Cover statement and one idea per slide, never body copy. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 44px / 50px | 650 | `sans` | Slide titles that carry the argument. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 28px / 36px | 650 | `sans` | Section titles and diagram labels. |
| `subhead` | `.subhead`, `--text-subhead` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | Deck lead-ins and card headings. |
| `stat` | `.stat`, `--text-stat` | 72px / 72px | 700 | `sans` | One number that proves a point; use at most one per slide. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Default slide body text. |
| `body-small` | `.body-small`, `--text-body-small` | 13.5px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Captions, dense table cells and UI-like detail. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 11.5px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Uppercase eyebrows and diagram captions; never full sentences. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Commands, identifiers, API names and token values. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "PingFang SC", "Segoe UI", Inter, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `Georgia, "Times New Roman", "Songti SC", STSong, SimSun, serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

4px base. The product UI is dense; slides use the same base with larger outer margins.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Inside compact controls. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Between related rows. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Card padding, UI. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Between groups. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between blocks. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Slide inner rhythm. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Slide margins on compact screens. |
| `space-24` | 96px | Outer slide margin at 1600×900. |

## Radius

Soft rectangles, one pill. Corners are quiet, never bubbly.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 6px | Small buttons and inputs. |
| `radius-md` | 8px | Buttons and compact controls. |
| `radius-lg` | 12px | Cards, menus and code panels. |
| `radius-xl` | 22px | Composer and large overlays. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Status pills only. |

## Shadow

Shadows explain elevation; they never decorate a flat surface.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-card) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px #201f1c4b · dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) | Cards and inputs at rest. |
| `shadow-pop` | 0 4px 16px rgba(32,31,28,0.08) · dark: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | Menus, popovers and floating panels. |
| `focus-ring` | 0 0 0 3px rgba(32,31,28,0.08) · dark: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.16) | Keyboard focus around inputs and interactive cards. |
